short_time_window: The available raster record supports short-window signals, not long-term ecological change claims.
season_definition: Season windows are defined in scripts/process_ecostress/config.yaml and should be named according to the months actually present in the raster inventory.
coverage: coverage_inside_aoi_percent represents finite valid pixels divided by total AOI pixels. Use observation_count and mean_valid_observations_per_aoi_pixel for confidence.
iss_overpass_timing: ECOSTRESS observations depend on ISS overpass timing and may not sample each period evenly.
crs: CRS was reported in raster inventory. Any suspicious CRS must be reviewed before map-based claims.
stability: Variability metrics are exploratory and should be interpreted cautiously.
metadata: AppEEARS statistics and XML metadata are used as provenance/QA context. Raster-derived outputs are calculated from raster files.
